response.sql: SELECT p.bats, COUNT(a.player_id) as appearance_count, CAST(COUNT(a.player_id) AS NUMERIC) / CAST(SUM(COUNT(a.player_id)) OVER () AS NUMERIC) as fraction_of_total, CAST(COUNT(a.player_id) AS NUMERIC) * CAST(COUNT(*) OVER () AS NUMERIC) / CAST(SUM(COUNT(a.player_id)) OVER () AS NUMERIC) as count_divided_by_average FROM appearances a INNER JOIN player p ON a.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.bats != '' GROUP BY p.bats
